# Zacks Investment Research

> > Zacks Investment Research provides investment research, stock analysis, and financial data to help investors make informed trading decisions.

Zacks is a leading investment research firm offering stock ratings, earnings estimates, portfolio tools, and market analysis. The platform serves individual investors and financial professionals with proprietary research methodologies and data-driven insights.

## Key Topics

- Investment Research
- Stock Analysis
- Earnings Estimates
- Portfolio Management
- Market Data
- Password Reset

- Self-Service Authentication
- User Enrollment
- Account Security
